mapper.sql: a.id, a.cors_account_id, a.account AS account_name, a.cors_status AS account_status, a.cors_activation_status AS activation_status, CASE WHEN a.cors_status = 'DISABLED' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN a.cors_status = 'ENABLED' AND a.cors_activation_status = 'WAITING_ACTIVATION' THEN 'WAITING_ACTIVATION' WHEN a.cors_status = 'ENABLED' AND a.cors_activation_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN a.cors_status = 'ENABLED' AND a.cors_activation_status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE NULL END AS status, a.spec_code, a.display_name, a.service_type, a.duration_days, a.owner_company_id, dc.company_name AS owner_company_name, a.assigned_user_id, a.account_source, a.source_service_code_id, sc.code AS source_service_code, a.exchange_batch_id, eb.exchange_batch_no, eb.request_id AS exchange_request_id, a.exchange_at, a.activated_at, a.expire_at, a.cors_created_at, a.cors_updated_at, a.last_sync_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at

FROM service_account a LEFT JOIN dealer_company dc ON dc.company_id = a.owner_company_id LEFT JOIN service_code sc ON sc.id = a.source_service_code_id LEFT JOIN service_code_generate_batch gb ON gb.id = sc.generate_batch_id LEFT JOIN exchange_batch eb ON eb.id = a.exchange_batch_id

sql.if: AND ( a.cors_account_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sc.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eb.request_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eb.exchange_batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR gb.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(a.id) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.cors_status = 'ENABLED' AND a.cors_activation_status = 'WAITING_ACTIVATION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS waiting, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.cors_status = 'ENABLED' AND a.cors_activation_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.cors_status = 'ENABLED' AND a.cors_activation_status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expired, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.cors_status = 'DISABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabled
